candidate.answer:
**Partial answer — points supported by the documentation:**

- Tracing records agent/app activity; evaluations measure performance against curated test cases; Signals score agent turns and apply tags and ratings to surface problems. [S2][S4]
- Weave gives visibility into agent sessions and multi-turn conversations or individual function calls; agent traces appear on the Agents page, weave.op calls on the Traces page, and both can be used in one project but produce separate traces. [S4][S6]
- Evaluations define metrics with scoring functions, compare evaluations across metrics and samples, track which model and prompt versions produced which performance, and benchmark/monitor performance. [S3]
- The Signals tab in the Agents view shows tags and ratings for agent conversations, flagging quality and safety problems (low-quality responses, frustrated users, NSFW) and highlighting traces needing attention. [S2]
- Creating a weave.Evaluation automatically enables its scorers as Signals for every agent turn. [S3]
